title: Prefix language from a length function
statement: Given a function $\ell$ from Boolean lists to natural numbers and a language $V$ of Boolean lists, a Boolean list $q$ belongs to the resulting language exactly when there is a Boolean list $s$ such that appending $s$ to the dropout-transduced second component decoded from $q$ gives a list of length $\ell$ of the first component decoded from $q$, and encoding that first component together with the appended list produces a member of $V$.
hypotheses_covered: A function from Boolean lists to natural numbers
caveat: The decoding, transduction, and pair-encoding operations are not fully defined in the provided material.
